intro: Selected builds — enterprise GenAI platforms and personal experiments.

items.title: Literature Surveillance (LS)
items.subtitle: GenAI-powered medical literature platform
items.description: Led frontend architecture and module-level scalability with full ownership of UI decisions for a GenAI-powered medical literature surveillance platform.
highlights: Built reusable components, a Google Forms-style dynamic form builder, and a custom XML previewer for structured documents (SRD/BMS).
Engineered a Google Drive-like file manager using WebSocket and RabbitMQ for real-time uploads and distributed processing.
Implemented article scheduling and retrieval across PubMed, Embase, and other sources with metadata-driven search filters.
Integrated GenAI/ML pipelines for automated content extraction and document generation from shortlisted articles.

items.title: Medical Writing Platform (MWP)
items.subtitle: Agent-based medical writing platform
items.description: Led frontend development of multiple React modules used in enterprise medical content workflows, including a Microsoft Word Add-in for in-document authoring.
highlights: Built reusable React components and custom hooks, improving maintainability by 40% and cutting feature development time by 25%.
Developed a Microsoft Word Add-in (React + Yeoman) for in-document authoring, driving 35% higher user adoption.
Delivered context-aware Word UI for authoring and review scenarios, reducing manual effort by 20%.

items.title: Intelligent Content Lifecycle Management (ICMS)
items.subtitle: Content lifecycle & workflow platform
items.description: Customized rich-text authoring with AI-driven content suggestions, real-time collaboration, SSO, and audit lineage graphs for a scalable workflow engine.
highlights: Customized TinyMCE for rich-text authoring with inline commenting, version control, and AI-driven content suggestions.
Integrated WebSocket real-time collaboration and Chart.js dashboards for workflow and document tracking.
Implemented Keycloak OAuth 2.0 SSO, RBAC, and multi-tenant authentication; built lineage graphs with ngx-graph for audit trails.
Contributed to a scalable workflow engine with dynamic review stages and global time-zone handling.

items.title: Slack Clone
items.subtitle: Real-time messaging app (personal project)
items.description: Real-time messaging app with Firebase Auth, channels, threads, typing indicators, and presence; responsive UI with Material UI.
highlights: Real-time channels, threads, typing indicators, and presence.
Firebase Authentication and Firestore for live data sync.
Responsive, component-driven UI with Material UI.
